description: Laboratory experiments are based upon the corresponding theory course EEPC-210. An updated list of experiments is floated by the course coordinator before the beginning of each semester.
outcomes: Understand the characteristics of various power devices.
Analyze various power device operations based on experiments.
Understand the performance analysis of various power converters.
Understand the operation of DC drives.
experiments: Study the characteristics of MOSFET, IGBT, SCR, TRIAC and DIAC.
Study the UJT as a relaxation oscillator.
Study commutation circuits of the SCR.
Study the performance of single-phase half controlled and fully controlled bridge rectifiers.
Simulate the single-phase controlled rectifier in PSIM and MATLAB.
Study the operation of a three-phase full wave rectifier circuit.
Study single-phase AC motor speed control using a TRIAC.
Study a single-phase dual converter and cycloconverter using MATLAB.
Study speed control of a DC motor using a three-phase fully controlled rectifier circuit using PSIM.
